verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs say the complete API surface ships in the open-source GPL-3.0 server, which you can self-host free forever. They list many install paths (Docker, Compose, Kubernetes, DEB/RPM, binaries, Terraform) and include a production best-practices guide, and AI features like Natural Language Search and RAG ship in the open-source server. missing for 10: explicit independent hands-on reports of self-hosted production deployments (community evidence only implies local use).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The complete API surface is available in the open-source server under GPL-3.0. Self-host it free forever or run the same engine in a dedicated Typesense Cloud cluster.
Typesense is an open source search engine that can be downloaded and run from your computer locally or from any server.
Docker Docker Compose Kubernetes Mac via Homebrew Mac Binary DEB package on Ubuntu/Debian RPM package on CentOS/RHEL Linux Binary Windows (WSL)
includes automatic Raft leader election in its open-source server, along with type validation, stable JOINs and nested filters, Natural Language Search, and RAG
